test_history.note: The same 390 test batteries were scored first by the PyTorch release and then by the NumPy implementation. NumPy configurations were chosen on validation, never from test results.

rules: Train the two frozen configurations with the listed seeds and evaluate their best validation checkpoints.
All three seeds are reported, do not select a winning seed from test.
The primary model family remains the candidate chosen before test, regardless of test ranking.
Domain feature engineering stays a validation ablation and is not added to this test comparison.
Keep original SOH units and un-clipped predictions, no resampling or test-driven threshold adjustment.
Test subgroup analyses are descriptive, not grounds for retuning against the same test set.
